name: kivin-monorepo
description: Bun single-binary, compile-time route-graph web framework
author: nori-kamiya

scripts.bench: bun run bench:build && bun run scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.bench:health: bun run bench:build && bun run scripts/benchmark-health.ts
scripts.bench:stack: bun run bench:stack:build && bun run scripts/benchmark-stack.ts
scripts.bench:kivin:create: bun run bench:stack:build && bun run scripts/benchmark-kivin-create.ts
scripts.bench:build: bun build examples/benchmark-kivin/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-kivin/bin/benchmark-kivin && bun build examples/benchmark-hono/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-hono/bin/benchmark-hono && bun build examples/benchmark-elysia/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-elysia/bin/benchmark-elysia
scripts.bench:stack:build: bun build examples/benchmark-stack-kivin/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-stack-kivin/bin/benchmark-stack-kivin && bun build examples/benchmark-stack-hono/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-stack-hono/bin/benchmark-stack-hono && bun build examples/benchmark-stack-elysia/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/benchmark-stack-elysia/bin/benchmark-stack-elysia
scripts.check: bun run generate && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --pretty false
scripts.generate: bun run packages/cli/src/bin.ts generate --entry examples/basic/src/app.ts --outDir examples/basic/.kivin/generated
scripts.inspect:routes: bun run packages/cli/src/bin.ts inspect routes --entry examples/basic/src/app.ts
scripts.inspect:modules: bun run packages/cli/src/bin.ts inspect modules --entry examples/basic/src/app.ts
scripts.release:check: bun run check && bun test && bun run example:smoke
scripts.example:build: bun run generate && bun build examples/basic/src/main.ts --compile --outfile examples/basic/bin/basic-app
scripts.example:smoke: bun run example:build && bun run scripts/example-smoke.ts
scripts.example:dev: bun run generate && bun run examples/basic/src/main.ts
